title: The Telescope Conjecture for Global Representations and FI-modules
summary: In this paper, we classify the localizing ideals of the derived category D(U) of global representations over a field k of characteristic zero, for various infinite families U of finite groups. These families include elementary abelian p-groups, cyclic p-groups, and cyclic groups of prime order together with the trivial group. We deduce that the telescope conjecture holds for these D(U). In particular, via Pontryagin duality, our results for elementary abelian p-groups also establish the telescope conjecture and the corresponding classification for derived VI-modules.
